# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/tool_docs.py from the registered tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

44 tools, 22 of them read-only. Tools that change anything are registered only with `OITC_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true`.

**Size** is the definition a model receives with every request - name, description and input schema as compact JSON - in characters. Roughly 3.1 to 3.7 characters make one token; see [tool-design.md](tool-design.md).

## `patch`

Update and security posture across the monitored estate.

4 tools, 4057 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `find_hosts` | reads | `name?`, `state?`, `container?`, `hostgroup?`, `acknowledged?`, `in_downtime?`, `limit?` | 1373 | Find hosts by name, state, container or host group, and count them per state. |
| `find_pending_updates` | reads | `security_only?`, `limit?`, `max_packages_per_host?` | 789 | Hosts with pending updates, with the package names and versions for each. |
| `get_host_health` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?` | 777 | How one host is doing: state and since when, what likely explains a problem (a down parent, a downtime, an acknowledgement), which hosts depend on it, its services by state, and recent state changes. |
| `list_installed_software` | reads | `hostname`, `name_filter?`, `only_updatable?`, `limit?` | 1118 | Software installed on a host, from the openITCOCKPIT agent's inventory. |

## `catalog`

Look up what exists - templates, commands, contacts, groups, containers - without changing anything.

3 tools, 3007 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `get_allowed_elements_for_container` | reads | `object_type`, `container_name?` | 1629 | List the host templates, contacts, contact groups, timeperiods, host groups, etc. that are actually visible from a given container - i.e. the values a Create* tool for that object_type would accept there. openITCOCKPIT restricts every such reference to the target container's own scope (the container plus its descendants, plus a few legacy tenant-wide exceptions); values outside that scope are rejected. |
| `get_container_tree` | reads | `container_name?` | 484 | Get the organizational structure (containers: tenants, locations, nodes) starting at the given container, including which hosts, host groups and service groups live directly under it. |
| `list_catalog` | reads | `kind`, `name?`, `limit?` | 894 | List templates, commands, contacts, groups or time periods by name, sorted by name, to find the exact name another tool needs. |
